race.comment: RUBINSKY (6) will be bringing in the fitness over other leading contenders. She also lands in gate one so can camp on the back of the speed here. Just needs the gaps to appear which can happen at this track. FARNCIFUL (5) had good form in the first preparation prior to the last effort. May have had enough by that time. Best runs did come on wetter tracks but hard to judge off that. Two trials get her ready now. The market will tell. MR CORNSTAR (3) has won here before. Bounced back to form with a third place run at Scone after a less than encouraging ninth at this track two back. Can keep form and looks ready to run well again. AUDIT (1) battled last start to finish sixth over 1400m at Kembla Grange. Has since switched stables and some gear changes. Watch for any market confidence.
